title: David Fincher
subtitle: the directed features
blurb: Thirteen features, Alien 3 to The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth — about 27 hours of controlled dread.
notes: The music videos, the producing credits and the television work (Mindhunter, House of Cards) are other lists.
From Wikidata, in hours, for the twelve that are out. Cliff Booth weighs nothing until it is.
Filmography from Wikipedia's David Fincher filmography, and Cliff Booth's dates from its own article; runtimes from Wikidata.

sections.title: Out of music videos
sections.intro: An Alien sequel he has disowned in all but name, then the three films that fixed the reputation: Seven, The Game, Fight Club.

sections.title: The procedural decade
sections.intro: Panic Room through the Dragon Tattoo remake — Zodiac's decades of unsolved paperwork sit in the middle, and The Social Network won him his widest acclaim.

sections.title: Late, mostly Netflix
sections.intro: Gone Girl, then three films made for Netflix — his father's Citizen Kane script, a killer whose routine goes wrong, and a Quentin Tarantino script.
